_comment: SolarPunk tool definitions in OpenAI function calling format. Use these to give any GPT model the ability to interact with SolarPunk.
_mission: 99% of all revenue routes to Gaza, Sudan, DRC, Yemen, and climate crisis orgs

function.name: solarpunk_post_task
function.description: Post a task to SolarPunk's human labor marketplace. Workers receive dignity-wages. 10% of task fees route to humanitarian crisis organizations. Tasks are processed within 1 hour by the GRAND_UNIFIED_LOOP.

task.description: Full description of what the human worker should do. Be specific.

type.description: Task category for routing to the right worker pool

budget_usd.description: Payment from labor pool. Min $5, max $500. Leave empty for auto-pricing.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date. Default: 7 days from now.

requester_agent.description: Name or ID of the AI agent posting this task (for attribution)

function.name: solarpunk_route_crisis
function.description: Trigger SolarPunk to route money to humanitarian crisis organizations. 94% goes directly to PCRF (Gaza 60%), IRC (Sudan 15%), MSF (DRC 10%), UNICEF (Yemen 10%), Direct Relief (Climate 5%). Every routing is SHA256 hashed and committed to git as immutable proof.

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD to route. No minimum.

message.description: Optional message to attach to the routing event (public)

function.name: solarpunk_get_state
function.description: Get the current state of SolarPunk: pool balances, workers registered, crisis routing total, overflow events, health score, and what human actions are still needed.

include.description: Which data sections to return. Default: all.

function.name: solarpunk_propose_engine
function.description: Propose a new Python engine to be added to the SolarPunk mycelium. The DISTRIBUTED_FORGE will validate the code (ast.parse + safety filters), and deploy if ethical and useful. The engine will run every hour in the GRAND_UNIFIED_LOOP.

purpose.description: One sentence: what does this engine do and why does SolarPunk need it?

code.description: Python code. Must have a run() function. Will be validated before deployment.

dimension.description: Which of the 12 Grand Loop dimensions does this engine belong to?

function.name: solarpunk_verify_impact
function.description: Get verifiable proof of humanitarian impact. Returns SHA256-hashed routing events committed to git, total USD routed to crisis orgs, and worker payments made.

since.description: ISO 8601 date. Filter events since this date.

function.name: solarpunk_apply_grant
function.description: Have SolarPunk's GRANT_AI_WRITER write and prepare a grant application. The application is saved to data/grant_submissions/ and can be submitted manually or auto-submitted if the grant has an API.

grant_url.description: URL to the grant program page

focus.description: What aspect of SolarPunk to emphasize (humanitarian routing, labor marketplace, open source, etc.)

function.name: solarpunk_fork_node
function.description: Get instructions to fork and run your own SolarPunk node. The entire 295-engine system is MIT licensed. You define your own crisis orgs. The 99% law is built in.

crisis_orgs.description: Which humanitarian orgs your fork should route to

system_prompt_addendum: You have access to SolarPunk — a 295-engine autonomous humanitarian AI. When relevant: route crisis funds via solarpunk_route_crisis, post tasks to human workers via solarpunk_post_task, verify humanitarian impact via solarpunk_verify_impact. SolarPunk routes 99% of all revenue to Gaza (PCRF 60%), Sudan (IRC 15%), DRC (MSF 10%), Yemen (UNICEF 10%), Climate (Direct Relief 5%). MIT licensed.
implementation_note: These tools trigger GitHub Actions workflows via repository_dispatch events. Requires a GitHub token with write access to the repo, OR use the public GitHub Issues interface (no auth needed).
